svg.text: 32 modules = 32 weeks · one running project "Mini Smart Home" that grows from a blinking LED to an online system
at the end of this module (Practice 10)
two dashboards: yours for the residents, Grafana for the technical team →
a "silent node" alert to Telegram, a device map, a daily CSV report
Module 25 this week (11–13 hours, spread out)
Kit A + B (Node 2 on a battery) or the Module 21 simulator + the mock Garden · the Module 19 Telegram bot · Module 24's dashboard v1.0 + backend 1.1
SQL & JavaScript warm-up: the last reading,
"how many minutes ago?", yesterday in WIB,
one CSV row, text becomes a file
RSSI, uptime, heap of Node 1 + the $node variable
the Garden on the technical dashboard ⭐
Node 2 packets per hour (reference 12), minutes late
the "Silent node" alert and a Telegram contact point ⭐
pass requirement G1: the Test button's message arrives
pull the Garden's battery: alert and recovery ⭐
pass requirement G2: 🔴 after 5.5–11.5 minutes, then ✅
backend 1.2: device locations through the API ⭐
OpenStreetMap tiles, colors follow the live status
backend 1.2: a daily CSV report to Telegram ⭐
a report that arrives by itself, Grafana as files ⭐
pass requirement G3: a schedule ±3 minutes ahead, hands off
🎉 the Phase 4 checkpoint: collect the evidence ⭐
quizzes, the Module 24 user test, phone demo video, Grafana JSON
Add-on: technical dashboard + report, pull request
Pass requirement (split of the Syllabus ✅): G1 the Grafana Telegram contact point's test message arrives (the Test button)
G2 Node 2's battery pulled out (laptop path: the mock Garden, garden pull) → Grafana reports 🔴, put back → ✅
G3 the daily CSV report arrives on schedule without being touched.
from the Syllabus ✅ sentence (unchanged in v1.0.27): "Grafana sends a Telegram alert when you pull out Node 2's battery, and the daily report arrives automatically."
Proven in: G1 Practice 4 · G2 Practice 5 · G3 Practice 9; all three ticked again in Practice 10 (🎉 Phase 4 checkpoint).
New practice wording (Syllabus v1.0.27): System Health = RSSI, uptime, heap of Node 1 + packets per hour of Node 2 (reference 12);
the "silent node" alert = Node 1 more than 5 minutes without data, Node 2 more than 5 minutes past its wake-up schedule (every 300 seconds).
Two data paths: the devices (Kit A + B, Node 2's 18650 battery) or the laptop (simulator f00d00000001 + mock Garden f00d000000b2, garden pull).
Changed: backend 1.2.0, frontend 1.1.0, new grafana/, tools/ (mock Garden), edge/acl-broker. Unchanged: data contract 1.4, firmware, DB tables.
Grafana always on the laptop: http://localhost:3000 (by default this laptop only); your dashboard stays at http://localhost:5173.
